items.title: Perfect World Posts 506 Million Yuan Third-Quarter Net Profit as Neverness to Everness Tops 2.7 Billion Yuan in Global Gross Billings
items.summary: Perfect World released its 2026 third-quarter report on October 29. Third-quarter revenue came in at CNY 2.362 billion, up 36.85% year over year, with…
items.content:
Add preferred source Perfect World released its 2026 third-quarter report on October 29. Third-quarter revenue came in at CNY 2.362 billion, up 36.85% year over year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of CNY 506 million and non-GAAP net profit of CNY 471 million. For the first nine months, cumulative revenue was CNY 5.113 billion, down 5.61% year over year, and net profit attributable to shareholders was CNY 387 million, down 41.83%, mainly due to a one-time gain from the prior-year sale of Chengfeng Studio that inflated the comparison base and to lower revenue from licensed games. The self-developed game Neverness to Everness launched its global open beta in April; as of October 28, cumulative global gross billings exceeded CNY 2.7 billion, with official PC and official Android channels accounting for nearly 60%, and overseas billings contributing more than those in China. The Film and Television Business posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of CNY 4.1445 million for the first nine months. Key Elements Perfect World Neverness to Everness 002624.SZ Chengfeng Studio Gaming Business Film and Television Business Official Global Channels Perfect World (002624.SZ) disclosed its 2026 third-quarter report on October 29. The sharp rebound in quarterly results was the most closely watched part of the filing: third-quarter revenue reached CNY 2.362 billion, up 36.85% year over year; net profit attributable to shareholders was CNY 506 million, and non-GAAP net profit was CNY 471 million.

On a cumulative basis, revenue for the first nine months was CNY 5.113 billion, down 5.61% year over year; net profit attributable to shareholders was CNY 387 million, down 41.83%; non-GAAP net profit was CNY 261 million, down 46.04%; and basic earnings per share were CNY 0.2. Net cash inflow from operating activities rose 32.87% year over year to CNY 1.181 billion.

The year-over-year decline in profit did not stem from a deterioration in the core business. The company said the Gaming Business posted net profit attributable to shareholders of CNY 434 million for the first nine months, down CNY 283 million from a year earlier, a key factor being a one-time disposal gain from the prior-year sale of Chengfeng Studio that raised the comparison base. On a non-GAAP basis, Gaming Business net profit attributable to shareholders was CNY 390 million, down CNY 157 million year over year, mainly dragged down by lower revenue from licensed games.

What actually drove the third-quarter profit release was the self-developed title Neverness to Everness. The game began its global open beta in April 2026, and as of October 28, cumulative global gross billings had exceeded CNY 2.7 billion (approximately $406.0 million), with official PC and official Android channels together contributing nearly 60%. Notably, cumulative billings from markets outside China exceeded those within China, underscoring a standout overseas performance. The company said Neverness to Everness is self-published by the company in the Chinese market and in most regions outside China, with its global publishing system supporting the product.

However, early-stage investment in the new game also weighed on the project's profitability at this stage. The company disclosed that a concentrated deployment of marketing resources ahead of the open beta led to elevated marketing expenses for Neverness to Everness during the reporting period, leaving the project's profit margin temporarily below normalized levels. That also means there is room for further profit upside as promotional spending gradually declines.

In contrast with the gaming segment, the Film and Television Business posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of CNY 4.1445 million (approximately $620,000) for the first nine months, a decline of CNY 35.8788 million from a year earlier; non-GAAP net loss attributable to shareholders was CNY 29.8002 million, a decline of CNY 55.6248 million year over year. The company attributed this mainly to the small number of film and television works aired and recognized as revenue during the reporting period.

Below is an overview of key financial metrics for the first nine months:

Note: Data sourced from the company's 2026 third-quarter report.

By segment, the Gaming Business posted net profit attributable to shareholders of CNY 434 million for the first nine months, or CNY 390 million on a non-GAAP basis; the Film and Television Business posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of CNY 4.1445 million, or a non-GAAP net loss of CNY 29.8002 million.

The company said some games saw year-over-year revenue declines in the first nine months due to factors such as product life cycles, but new titles have picked up the baton, with profit contribution from self-developed games rising steadily year over year and adding fresh vitality to its evergreen game portfolio.

From a market perspective, the key takeaway from this report is the shift in the earnings mix. Neverness to Everness alone pushed quarterly net profit attributable to shareholders back above CNY 500 million, showing that new self-developed titles have begun to replace older products as the profit mainstay; the fact that overseas billings outpaced those in China also validates the company's ability to execute its self-publishing system in markets outside China. For investors, two variables bear watching: the pace of margin recovery for Neverness to Everness as promotional spending declines, and the continued drag on overall revenue from falling licensed-game revenue and limited revenue recognition in the Film and Television Business. Whether the third quarter's rise in both revenue and profit can extend into the fourth quarter will depend on the stability of billings from new titles and the衔接 of the product pipeline.

items.title: GTA-Inspired PS5 Open World Goes Full Tycoon in Upcoming Update
items.summary: Manage city logistics in new mode
items.content:
The real GTA 6 may be right around the corner, but Hotta Studio’s anime-inspired open world NTE is getting a big update on 11th November to keep you occupied in the meantime.

And as has become customary for Heathereau, there’s a lot to look forward to here, including two new characters, story quests, and more.

But watching through the preview livestream last night , the thing that jumped out to me is the new City Logistics management minigame.

In the current version of NTE you can take on delivery jobs all around the open world. But in v1.5 you’ll be able to recruit staff and assign them work which will transform this aspect of the game into more of a tycoon management experience.

Regular readers will know I love when my open world has a side helping of business sim, so I’m really looking forward to sinking my teeth into this.

Other new activities include an in-game board game you can buy, which adds some tycoon-themed puzzles to the title. And there’s a new tank vehicle you can take online in a competitive deathmatch-style minigame.

This update will run through 23rd December so you’ll have plenty of time to catch up on its activities alongside GTA 6. I’m really looking forward to getting to grips with the new business activities.

Review NTE: Neverness to Everness (PS5) - Ambitious Anime Open World Gets a Lot Right

items.title: NTE codes October 2026
items.summary: Our list of Neverness to Everness (NTE) codes and 1.2 livestream codes will help you claim free Annulith, which will help you roll for new S-Class characters.
items.content:
Image credit: Hotta Studio Guide by Dion Dassanayake Contributing Guides Writer Updated on Oct. 28, 2026, 3:50 p.m. Follow Neverness to Everness Prioritise us on Google 28th October 2026 : We added new NTE livestream codes. Neverness to Everness codes will help you claim free Annulith so you can roll for new characters in the GTA-like gacha game. The free-to-play RPG is set in a Tokyo-like metropolis known as Hethereau, where supernatural events known as Anomalies occur.

While it's up to you to hunt down these Anomalies, the game is all about player freedom and there's tonnes of other things you can do including street races, taking on part-time jobs and buying your own luxury apartment. There's even a GTA-style wanted system and you can end up in jail! If you need a hand on your adventures, you can always use NTE codes to get rewards like free Annulith which will help you roll for new S-Class characters. Codes are shared on the official NTE Discord server , but to save you time we've rounded up the latest codes below including the NTE 1.5 livestream codes .

Here are all the working NTE codes as of 28th October 2026:

Think we can make our code pages better? Help us level up by taking our quick survey .

Neverness to Everness players can also claim free rewards that were shared in the 1.5 livestream. These NTE livestream codes are only available for a limited amount of time, so you need to be quick in redeeming them!

The NTE 1.5 livestream codes, which were shared in an online broadcast that detailed the 'Once Upon a Glitched Call' update , will only be available until Sunday 1st November 2026 at 3.59pm GMT.

Not sure how to redeem codes in Neverness to Everness? Here's what you need to do:

Run out of NTE codes to redeem? If you pre-registered for NTE then you'll have plenty of extra freebies waiting for you in your inbox.

Simply head to the 'Mail' section and find the message titled 'Pre-Reg Milestone Rewards' to claim the goodies. Here's everything you can get if you pre-registered:

Besides NTE codes, you can also get freebies for Neverness to Everness at launch by taking advantage of Twitch Drops. Twitch Drops let you claim rewards for NTE by watching participating streams.

If this sounds like something you're interested in, then here's what you need to do:

The number of rewards you get depends on how long you watch a participating stream. Here's the NTE rewards you can get and how long you need to watch a Twitch stream to get it:

Once you've unlocked a reward, you'll need to head to your Twitch Drops Inventory and claim it so you receive it in-game.

At launch NTE players can also claim the A-Class Aurelia character for free. Aurelia is a login bonus for Neverness to Everness, and all you need to do to get the character is login to NTE for three consecutive days.

items.title: Everything revealed for Neverness to Everness Version 1.5–Exe, Elyms, vehicles, events
items.summary: NTE's Version 1.5 will introduce new S-Class characters, two new vehicles, fresh events, and more.
items.content:
All News NTE Version 1.5 brings characters Exe and Elyms, plus new vehicles and events (Image: Hotta Studio).

{" "} Everything revealed for Neverness to Everness Version 1.5–Exe, Elyms, vehicles, events .iframe-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .img-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .a-img-media {aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} NTE's Version 1.5 will introduce new S-Class characters, two new vehicles, fresh events, and more. Neverness to Everness (NTE) has unveiled everything coming in Version 1.5, titled “Once Upon a Glitched Call”. The update will embrace a tech-themed aesthetic, which ties in with its upcoming characters, ETD-6 Lieutenant Elyms and Captain Exe .

Appraisers will embark on a new story exploring the “friction” between the ETD-6 leaders, leading them into a new anomalous realm featuring its own unique boss. In addition, two new vehicles have been revealed, alongside a fresh line-up of events and activities.

We break down everything coming to NTE Version 1.5, as revealed during the livestream, below.

Version 1.5 kicks off with Elyms’ limited-time banner, “Android Dreams”, running from 11 November to 2 December. Her featured Arc banner, “Echo Special”, will run for the same duration, featuring her signature Arc, “Echoes on Hold”.

Elyms is an S-Class Cosmos Esper described as bubbly and easygoing. She will join the ranks of the game’s Cosmos characters, including Zero, Hotori, and Shinku. Her Arc compatibility is Solid, allowing her to use Arcs such as Reality Refuge and Day Off. However, her signature Arc, “Echoes on Hold”, would be the best option. As a Burst DPS, she also provides DMG Boost support for the team.

If you’re planning to pull for Elyms, start farming the following materials to level her up as soon as possible.

At launch, Elyms will also have three outfits. Drifting Petals can be obtained by reaching the required number of pulls on her banner, while Windflower unlocks when you reach Bond Level 10. Her third outfit, “Y2K Mystique”, can be purchased directly from the Mall.

Elyms is voiced by Crystal Lee, who also voices Clorinde in Genshin Impact, Jean Grey in Marvel Rivals, and Alexandrina Sebastiane in Zenless Zone Zero.

Exe’s limited-time banner, “Offline Equations”, will arrive in the second half of NTE Version 1.5 along with his Arc banner “Encryption Special”, which features his signature Arc “Dotted Horizon”.

Despite working closely with Elyms to lead ETD-6, Exe is her polar opposite. Cold and level-headed, he is also said to be an elite hacker who operates under an alias.

Exe is a Chaos Esper, making him only the third character with this Esper element, alongside Daffodil and Lacrimosa. His Arc compatibility is Plasma, allowing him to use Arcs such as Raging Flames and Song of the Whale. However, his signature Arc, “Dotted Horizon”, is expected to be his best option. Exe specialises in Main DPS and is a Summoner.

If you’re planning to pull for Exe, start farming the following materials to level him up as soon as possible.

Exe will also receive three outfits at launch. Blue Snow can be obtained by reaching the required number of pulls on his banner, while X% unlocks at Bond Level 10. His third outfit, “Untouched by Rain”, can be purchased directly from the Mall.

items.title: Neverness to Everness Battles in Tanks! Version 1.5 Livestream Recap Featuring Elyms and Exe
items.summary: On Wednesday, October 28 at 8:30 PM, the Version 1.5 preview special program for 'Neverness to Everness,' titled 'Once Upon a Glitched Call,' aired via the official YouTube channel.
items.content:
Update drops Wednesday, November 11: New story, logistics management, animal cars, and more

Korean (한국어) KO Add us on On Wednesday, October 28 at 8:30 PM, the Version 1.5 preview special program for 'Neverness to Everness,' titled 'Once Upon a Glitched Call,' aired via the official YouTube channel. The broadcast unveiled new S-Rank characters Elyms and Exe, alongside a new main story set in digital space, logistics center management, tank battles, and other fresh content. Version 1.5 will update on November 11 and run until December 23, with Phase 1 and Phase 2 lasting 21 days each .

300 Total Annuliths: 3 Special Livestream Redemption Codes

Three redemption codes were revealed during the stream: INVALIDNUMBER, HIOLDFRIEND, and EXENORESPONSE. Each code awards 100 Annuliths alongside development materials, and all are valid until November 2 at 16:59 (KST) . To claim the rewards, the in-game mailbox feature must be unlocked before the expiration deadline.

The new main story 'Meet Me in the Data Stream' begins with an urban legend spreading through Hethereau titled 'Invalid Number.' People meet an old friend in their dreams, but upon waking, only a single phone number remains in their memory. Calling that number yields only an automated notice that the number does not exist. Despite being unable to reach anyone, the number lingers in their minds, leading to a wave of reports from others experiencing the same thing.

Exe, the Captain of ETD Team 6 specializing in information technology, and Lieutenant Elyms become involved in the incident. Suspicious aspects of the Bureau's response emerge as the two personally leave warning comments on related posts. The relationship between the two and the mysteries surrounding Elyms will also be explored in this story.

The stage for adventure expands into a vast network space connected to the 'Invalid Number.' Environments range from a submerged city with block-shaped buildings lining above and below the digital sea to spaces reminiscent of vintage computers and operating system windows. Battles against boss-level Anomalies have also been teased in this location where even every pebble is composed of data.

ETD Team 6 Leaders Elyms and Exe Join the Roster

Light-Attribute Rapid-Cycle Elyms and Dark-Attribute Ranged DPS Exe

Phase 1's new S-Rank character Elyms is the Lieutenant of ETD Team 6. Bubbly and playful by nature, she is skilled at mediating conflicts and soothing others. The smartphone she never lets go of turns into a secret weapon when stepping into combat.

As a Light-attribute unit, Elyms possesses the 'Rapid Cycle' trait, which immediately maxes out her cycle meter upon using her Birail Skill. She supports the party with passives that empower Charge and Remora, while managing 'Signal Strength' in battle. Completing her basic attack chain at Weak Signal prepares her enhanced skill, and using Support Skills and enhanced skills elevates the signal tier to Moderate Signal and Strong Signal.

Her Ultimate switches between single-target and AoE modes based on the number of enemies previously identified. Higher Signal Strength upon activation increases damage for her Ultimate and subsequent joint attacks, while granting an ATK buff to party members other than herself. After casting her Ultimate, she can continue executing off-field joint attacks for a set duration.

Phase 2 sees the arrival of Exe, Captain of ETD Team 6 and a hidden hacker. Typically expressionless and prioritizing efficiency, he quietly handles tasks others shy away from. In the open world, he can utilize his Esper ability to move between billboards.

Exe's combat revolves around 'Frames' and 'Ranks.' He accumulates Frames through attacks and outputs Digital Spectrums to deal extra damage. Successfully landing combos, using skills, executing Perfect Evasions, and launching counterattacks elevates his rank from B to A, S, SS, and SSS; higher ranks allow him to accumulate Frames more efficiently.

items.content:
The "Dazzling Star" Limited Board is coming soon! Roll for a chance to get Akane Rin, the featured limited S-class character!

● Available

October 21, 2026 (after update) – November 11, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8)

● Unlock Requirement

Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

● Featuring

1. The "Dazzling Star" board features the limited S-class character Akane Rin, along with A-class characters Haniel, Aurelia, and Skia.

2. Also on the "Dazzling Star" board: "Day Adrift" glider, "Starbeat Rush" Yesteryear bike livery, and Akane's "Shining Idol" outfit.

● Board Rules

1. The "Dazzling Star" board uses Solid Dice or Void Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.

2. All Limited Boards share the same S-class character pity counter, Points Gift progress, and Board Modification progress.

3. Skin Perks for the "Dazzling Star" board are time-limited and exclusive to this board. Progress does not carry over to other Limited Boards. Skin Perks for this board include: Daily Outfit, Mod Up! (Livery), and Fashion Center.

4. All boards start as Baseline. If the featured S-class character doesn't drop within 70 consecutive rolls, the board upgrades to Modified (rate up). Once you obtain the featured S-class character, the board resets to Baseline.

5. If you haven't obtained the featured S-class character after 89 rolls, your 90th roll automatically grants them (your piece will not move). The featured S-class character is guaranteed within 90 rolls.

6. Akane Rin is currently only available from the "Dazzling Star" Limited Board, with no other ways to obtain her planned at this time.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

items.content:
Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins! Collect Wonder Stamps and unlock your exclusive park memories.

● Available

September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

● Rewards

During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

●Pukaland Gameplay Overview

Candy Jar Raid

"In Candy Jar Raid, press the corresponding Movement keys to rotate your view, and hold the Shoot key to fire. Switch between Cannonballs and Forks depending on the situation.

Use Cannonballs to knock back approaching octopus tentacles and protect the cup's Durability. Use Forks to collect Treasure Chests and Treasure Maps for points. Be careful—if the cup's Durability reaches zero, the game will end early with a low rating."

"If a powerful tentacle grabs you, quickly repel the other attacking tentacles to avoid losing a large amount of points and durability.

Collect all Treasure Maps to unlock a special challenge stage. Defeat all Golden Tentacles to clear the challenge and unlock a special ending. Give it your all!"

Flora Maze

"In Flora Maze, players spawn at random locations, and the maze layout changes each round.

Explore the maze, find the exit, and escape! Collect all the scattered playing cards and rescue every trapped Pukaboo to earn additional rewards."

"Lollipop Goggles reveal the location of the exit, but also make the timer run faster. Pick up other items to gain more time. Approach special bushes to uncover hidden paths—but be careful, some bushes move on their own!

If you fail to escape before time runs out, the challenge will end early with a low rating. Good luck out there!"

Pixies Waltz

"In Pixies Waltz, press the corresponding direction when the green cursor reaches the center of the button to build Firepower.

Your timing will be rated Perfect, Normal, or Miss."

"Reach the top of the tower to enter first-person shooting mode. Spend Firepower to shoot down airborne candy and earn points!

If half of the Firepower you gain in a single run is earned with a Perfect rating, a special challenge stage will unlock. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"

Punchulum Ride

"In the Punchulum Ride, press the corresponding Movement key when each circle appears to earn points.

There are three types of inputs: press, hold, and repeated press. Watch the colors carefully to know which one to use.

Pink Candy Ring: Press once

Blue Candy Ring: Hold

Orange Candy Ring: Press repeatedly"

"Mistakes increase your character's Fear, while successful inputs reduce it. If Fear gets too high, the game will end early and you'll receive a low rating.

Land multiple Perfects to unlock a special challenge stage. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"

Lavaton Gold Rush

In Lavaton Gold Rush, use the Movement and Jump keys to control the mine cart. Switch between adjacent tracks to dodge obstacles, pick up weapons to destroy them, and collect coins to earn points.

"While airborne, you can steer the mine cart left or right to choose which track to land on, though your movement will be limited during lava eruptions. On steep tracks, press the Speed Up key to make it up the slope.

Hitting obstacles or derailing will cost you points. Lose too many points, and the game will end early with a low score."

items.summary: ● Available September 30, 2026 (after update) – October 21, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8) ● Unlock Requirement Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop" ● Featuring 1. The "Foretold Finale" board features t
items.content:
● Available

September 30, 2026 (after update) – October 21, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8)

● Unlock Requirement

Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

● Featuring

1. The "Foretold Finale" board features the limited S-class character Blackbird, along with A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

2. The board also features "The Harbinger" glider livery, the "Nightplume" Yesteryear bike livery, and Blackbird's "Rouge et Noir" outfit.

● Board Rules

1. The "Foretold Finale" board uses Solid Dice or Divination Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.

2. All Limited Boards share the same S-class character pity counter, Points Gift progress, and Board Modification progress.

3. Skin Perks on "Foretold Finale" are time-limited and exclusive to this board. Progress does not carry over to other Limited Boards. Skin Perks for this board include: Daily Outfit, Mod Up! (Livery), and Fashion Center.

4. All boards start as Baseline. If the featured S-class character doesn't drop within 70 consecutive rolls, the board upgrades to Modified (rate up). Once you obtain the featured S-class character, the board resets to Baseline.

5. If you haven't obtained the featured S-class character after 89 rolls, your 90th roll automatically grants them (your piece will not move). The featured S-class character is guaranteed within 90 rolls.

6. Blackbird is currently only available from the "Foretold Finale" Limited Board, with no other ways to obtain her planned at this time.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.
